restricted_silk_nb_probe.status: desktop prototype; not a CLDC port or full Opus decoder
constraints: 12kHz mono output, default zero decoder gain
no lost packet,PLC,FEC or mode transitions
reject if ec.tell()+17 <=8*payloadBytes, indicating possible CELT redundancy
restricted_silk_nb_probe.test_harness:
import java.io.*;import java.util.*;import org.concentus.*;
public class TestSilkNb{public static void main(String[] a)throws Exception{DataInputStream in=new DataInputStream(new FileInputStream(a[0]));if(in.readInt()!=0x4f504b31)throw new Exception("magic");int count=in.readInt(),good=0;OpusDecoder ref=null;SilkNbOnlyProbe restricted=null;for(int i=0;i<count;i++){if(i==0||i==96||i==2666){ref=new OpusDecoder(12000,1);restricted=new SilkNbOnlyProbe();}byte[] p=new byte[in.readUnsignedShort()];in.readFully(p);short[] expected=new short[240],actual=new short[240];int n=ref.decode(p,0,p.length,expected,0,240,false);int m=restricted.decode(p,actual);if(n!=m||!Arrays.equals(expected,actual))throw new Exception("PCM mismatch "+i);good++;}System.out.println("SILK-NB restricted PCM exact vs full Concentus packets="+good);}}
